name: wait_for_omnimed_rebuild
cmd: for i in $(seq 1 2400); do [ -s feats_hidden/generator_eval_omnimed_open.npz ] && [ -s ckpts/openvqa/cheap_lingshu7b/ckpt_omnimed_open_lingshu7b.judge.jsonl ] && exit 0; sleep 60; done; echo 'TIMED OUT waiting for the omnimed rebuild'; exit 1

name: redo_free_signal_bakeoff
cmd: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 HEAD_SWEEP_THREADS=4; python3 -u src/cascade_methods/free_signal_bakeoff.py --cells all

name: redo_regime_detector
